segments.text: Your deep troubles for the defectiveness of your obedience, doth not argue you to be less, but more sanctified, than those who make no such complaints: for this proves you to be better acquainted with your own hearts, than others are, to have a deeper hatred of sin than others have, and to love God with a more fervent love than others do: the most eminent Saints have made the bitterest complaints upon this account, Psal. 65. 3. Rom. 7. 23, 24.
